name: Flat Barbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Flat bench inside power rack or bench station. Bar at chest height, spotter recommended. Feet flat, shoulder blades retracted. Unrack, lower bar to mid-chest — press up to lockout.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Incline bench (30-45 degrees) inside power rack. Bar at chest height, spotter recommended. Feet flat, shoulder blades retracted. Unrack, lower bar to upper chest — press up to lockout.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Decline bench inside power rack, feet secured. Bar at chest height, spotter recommended. Shoulder blades retracted. Unrack, lower bar to lower chest — press up to lockout.

name: Flat Dumbbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Flat bench with dumbbell rack nearby. Start with dumbbells on thighs, kick up to pressing position. Retract shoulder blades.

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Incline bench with dumbbell rack nearby. Start with dumbbells on thighs, kick up to pressing position. Retract shoulder blades.

name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
setupNotes: Decline bench with dumbbell rack nearby. Start with dumbbells on thighs, kick up to pressing position. Retract shoulder blades.

name: Flat Machine Chest Press — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Flat chest press machine — adjust seat so handles align with mid-chest. Grip overhand with palms down, back against pad, feet flat. Press handles forward to full extension — targets chest with triceps assistance.

name: Flat Machine Chest Press — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Flat chest press machine — adjust seat so handles align with mid-chest. Grip neutral with palms facing each other, back against pad, feet flat. Press handles forward to full extension — targets chest with less shoulder strain.

name: Incline Machine Chest Press — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Incline chest press machine — adjust seat so handles align with upper chest. Grip overhand with palms down, back against pad, feet flat. Press handles forward and slightly up — targets upper chest and front delts.

name: Incline Machine Chest Press — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Incline chest press machine — adjust seat so handles align with upper chest. Grip neutral with palms facing each other, back against pad, feet flat. Press handles forward and slightly up — targets upper chest with less shoulder strain.

name: Decline Machine Chest Press — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Decline chest press machine — adjust seat so handles align with lower chest. Grip overhand with palms down, back against pad, feet flat. Press handles forward and slightly down — targets lower chest fibres.

name: Decline Machine Chest Press — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Decline chest press machine — adjust seat so handles align with lower chest. Grip neutral with palms facing each other, back against pad, feet flat. Press handles forward and slightly down — targets lower chest with less shoulder strain.

name: Cable Chest Fly — Low
setupNotes: Dual cable station, pulley set at low position. D-handles attached. Step forward to create tension, slight bend in elbows throughout.

name: Cable Chest Fly — Mid
setupNotes: Dual cable station, pulley set at mid position. D-handles attached. Step forward to create tension, slight bend in elbows throughout.

name: Cable Chest Fly — High
setupNotes: Dual cable station, pulley set at high position. D-handles attached. Step forward to create tension, slight bend in elbows throughout.

name: Pec Deck Machine
setupNotes: Adjust seat height so arms are at chest level. Pads or handles at shoulder width. Back firmly against pad, slight elbow bend.

name: Flat Dumbbell Chest Fly
setupNotes: Flat bench with moderate dumbbells. Arms extended above chest, slight elbow bend. Lower in arc until stretch is felt.

name: Incline Dumbbell Chest Fly
setupNotes: Incline bench with moderate dumbbells. Arms extended above chest, slight elbow bend. Lower in arc until stretch is felt.

name: Decline Dumbbell Chest Fly
setupNotes: Decline bench with moderate dumbbells. Arms extended above chest, slight elbow bend. Lower in arc until stretch is felt.

name: Standing Landmine Press
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment or wedged in corner. Stand facing away for chest focus, grip end of bar at chest height. Staggered stance.

name: Kneeling Landmine Press
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment or wedged in corner. Half-kneel facing the bar, grip end of bar at chest with both hands. Press up and forward in an arc to full extension — targets upper chest and front delts while removing lower-body drive.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Press — Left Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment or wedged in corner. Stand in staggered stance, grip end of bar with one hand at shoulder. Press up and forward in an arc to full extension — targets chest and shoulder with unilateral core demand.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Press — Right Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment or wedged in corner. Stand in staggered stance, grip end of bar with one hand at shoulder. Press up and forward in an arc to full extension — targets chest and shoulder with unilateral core demand.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
setupNotes: Lie on floor with dumbbell. Knees bent, feet flat. Upper arms touch floor at bottom of each rep.

name: Barbell Floor Press
setupNotes: Lie on floor with barbell. Knees bent, feet flat. Upper arms touch floor at bottom of each rep.

name: Chest Dip
setupNotes: Parallel bar dip station. Lean torso forward ~30 degrees, elbows flare slightly out. Wider grip emphasises chest over triceps.

name: Push-Up (Standard)
setupNotes: Hands shoulder-width on floor, body in straight line from head to heels. Full range — chest to floor, arms fully extended at top.

name: Isometric Chest Hold
setupNotes: Machine chest press or cable crossover. Press to mid-range and hold for prescribed time. Constant tension on chest throughout.

name: Flat Slow Tempo Push-Up
setupNotes: Standard push-up position — hands shoulder-width on floor, body in straight line. Lower for 3–4 seconds, pause 1 second at bottom, press up with control. Tempo work builds chest time-under-tension.

name: Incline Slow Tempo Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands elevated on bench or box, feet on floor, body in straight line. Lower chest toward bench for 3–4 seconds, pause 1 second at bottom, press up with control. Tempo work builds lower-chest endurance at an easier angle.

name: Decline Slow Tempo Push-Up
setupNotes: Feet elevated on bench or box, hands on floor shoulder-width, body in straight line. Lower chest toward floor for 3–4 seconds, pause 1 second at bottom, press up with control. Tempo work emphasises upper chest and shoulders.

name: Explosive Push-Up
setupNotes: Standard push-up position on firm floor. Explode upward so hands leave the ground. Land softly with slight elbow bend. Advanced movement.

name: Chest Stretch Cable Press
setupNotes: Single cable pulley at chest height. Step forward, press arm across body with slow controlled motion. Full stretch at the back position.

name: Svend Press
setupNotes: Standing, hold two small plates squeezed together at chest height. Press outward while maintaining squeeze. Constant chest contraction.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press — Underhand Grip
setupNotes: Seated on bench with back support, feet flat. Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing you (underhand). Press overhead to full lockout — lower with control.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Seated on bench with back support, feet flat. Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing each other (neutral). Press overhead to full lockout — lower with control.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Seated on bench with back support, feet flat. Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward (overhand). Press overhead to full lockout — lower with control.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press — Underhand Grip
setupNotes: Standing, feet shoulder-width apart, core braced. Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing you (underhand). Press overhead to full lockout — lower with control.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Standing, feet shoulder-width apart, core braced. Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing each other (neutral). Press overhead to full lockout — lower with control.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Standing, feet shoulder-width apart, core braced. Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward (overhand). Press overhead to full lockout — lower with control.

name: Seated Barbell Overhead Press
setupNotes: Seated, barbell in front rack position at collarbone. Feet hip-width. Press straight overhead, lock out, bar over mid-foot.

name: Standing Barbell Overhead Press
setupNotes: Standing, barbell in front rack position at collarbone. Feet hip-width. Press straight overhead, lock out, bar over mid-foot.

name: Machine Shoulder Press — Underhand Grip
setupNotes: Adjust seat so handles start at ear level. Back against pad, feet flat. Press to full extension. Use underhand grip position.

name: Machine Shoulder Press — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Adjust seat so handles start at ear level. Back against pad, feet flat. Press to full extension. Use neutral grip position.

name: Machine Shoulder Press — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Adjust seat so handles start at ear level. Back against pad, feet flat. Press to full extension. Use overhand grip position.

name: Lateral Raise — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing, light dumbbells at sides. Raise arms out to sides until parallel with floor, slight bend in elbows. Controlled lowering.

name: Lateral Raise — Cable
setupNotes: Single low cable pulley, D-handle. Stand sideways to machine. Raise arm out to side to shoulder height. Constant cable tension.

name: Behind-the-Back Cable Lateral Raise
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, D-handle passed behind back. Stand sideways. Raise arm to side — cable behind body keeps tension through full range.

name: Front Raise — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbells in front of thighs. Raise one or both arms forward to shoulder height, palms down. Controlled lowering.

name: Front Raise — Plate
setupNotes: Standing, grip a weight plate at 3 and 9 o'clock. Raise to shoulder height with arms extended. Controlled tempo.

name: Rear Delt Fly — Machine
setupNotes: Sit facing pad on pec deck / rear delt machine. Grip handles with arms extended. Pull handles back in arc, squeezing rear delts.

name: Rear Delt Fly — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Bent over at hips ~45 degrees, dumbbells hanging below chest. Raise arms out to sides, leading with elbows. Light weight, controlled.

name: Arnold Press
setupNotes: Seated on upright bench with back support. Start with dumbbells at chin, palms facing you. Rotate palms outward as you press overhead.

name: EZ-Bar Upright Row
setupNotes: Standing, grip ez-bar at hip width. Pull straight up along body to chin level, elbows high.

name: Cable Upright Row
setupNotes: Standing, grip cable at hip width. Pull straight up along body to chin level, elbows high.

name: Barbell Upright Row
setupNotes: Standing, grip barbell at hip width. Pull straight up along body to chin level, elbows high.

name: Standing Cable Face Pull
setupNotes: Cable at upper-chest height, rope attachment. Pull toward face, hands ending beside ears. Elbows high, squeeze rear delts. Standing.

name: Kneeling Cable Face Pull
setupNotes: Cable at upper-chest height, rope attachment. Pull toward face, hands ending beside ears. Elbows high, squeeze rear delts. Kneeling.

name: Scapular Retraction Pull
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar with arms fully extended. Without bending elbows, depress and retract shoulder blades to lift body slightly.

name: Isometric Lateral Hold — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing, raise light dumbbells to shoulder height laterally. Hold position for prescribed time. Maintain slight elbow bend.

name: Y-Raise — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Prone on incline bench (face down) or standing bent over. Raise dumbbells in Y-shape overhead. Light weight, controlled.

name: Cuban Rotation — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing, elbows at 90 degrees at shoulder height. Rotate forearms from pointing down to pointing up. Prehab / rotator cuff work.

name: Lu Raise
setupNotes: Standing with light dumbbells. Front raise to shoulder height, then continue into lateral raise position without lowering. Smooth arc motion.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Shoulder Press — Left Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment, staggered stance. Grip end of bar at shoulder with one hand. Press upward in an arc until arm is extended — lower slowly.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Shoulder Press — Right Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment, staggered stance. Grip end of bar at shoulder with one hand. Press upward in an arc until arm is extended — lower slowly.

name: Double-Arm Landmine Shoulder Press
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment, staggered stance. Grip end of bar at chest with both hands. Press upward in an arc until arms are extended — lower slowly.

name: Barbell Shrug
setupNotes: Standing, barbell held at hip level with overhand grip, shoulder-width. Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears. Brief hold at top, controlled lower.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
setupNotes: Standing, heavy dumbbells at sides. Shrug shoulders up toward ears, hold 1 second at top. Keep arms straight throughout.

name: Trap Bar Shrug
setupNotes: Standing inside trap bar loaded with weight. Grip handles, arms straight. Shrug shoulders up toward ears. Neutral grip reduces wrist strain.

name: Smith Machine Shrug
setupNotes: Stand centred in Smith machine, bar at hip level. Overhand grip, shoulder-width. Shrug straight up — machine guides the path.

name: Cable Shrug
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, straight bar or rope attachment. Stand upright, arms straight. Shrug shoulders upward against cable resistance.

name: Rack Pull — Above Knee
setupNotes: Barbell on power rack pins set above knee height. Conventional deadlift grip. Stand up to lockout, squeeze traps and upper back at top.

name: Rack Pull — Below Knee
setupNotes: Barbell on power rack pins set below knee height. Conventional deadlift grip. Stand up to lockout, squeeze traps and upper back at top.

name: Lat Pulldown — Wide Grip
setupNotes: Cable lat pulldown machine, wide bar attached. Sit with thighs under pad, grip bar wider than shoulder-width. Pull to upper chest, squeeze lats.

name: Lat Pulldown — Neutral/Close Grip
setupNotes: V-handle or close-grip attachment on lat pulldown. Sit upright, pull to chest, elbows close to body. Squeeze at bottom.

name: Lat Pulldown — Reverse Grip — Close Grip
setupNotes: Straight bar on lat pulldown, underhand (supinated) grip, hands close together. Pull bar to upper chest — lean back slightly, squeeze lats at bottom.

name: Lat Pulldown — Reverse Grip — Standard Grip
setupNotes: Straight bar on lat pulldown, underhand (supinated) grip, hands shoulder-width apart. Pull bar to upper chest — lean back slightly, squeeze lats at bottom.

name: Standard Lat Pulldown — Machine
setupNotes: Plate-loaded or selectorised lat pulldown machine. Adjust thigh pad. Grip handles, pull to upper chest with controlled form.

name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown — Left Arm
setupNotes: Cable lat pulldown, D-handle attachment. One arm at a time, slight lean toward working side. Full stretch at top, squeeze at bottom.

name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown — Right Arm
setupNotes: Cable lat pulldown, D-handle attachment. One arm at a time, slight lean toward working side. Full stretch at top, squeeze at bottom.

name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
setupNotes: Loop resistance band over pull-up bar, step one or both feet into band. Perform pull-up with band support reducing bodyweight load.

name: Machine-Assisted Pull-Up
setupNotes: Assisted pull-up / dip machine. Kneel or stand on pad, select counterweight. Grip bar overhead, pull chin above bar.

name: Standard Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar at height allowing full hang. Overhand grip just outside shoulder-width. Pull chin over bar, full extension at bottom.

name: Chin-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, underhand (supinated) grip at shoulder-width. Pull chin over bar, squeezing biceps and lats. Full hang at bottom.

name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, overhand grip significantly wider than shoulders. Pull chest toward bar. More lat emphasis, less bicep.

name: Close-Grip Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, overhand grip with hands touching or 6 inches apart. Pull chin over bar. More bicep and lower lat involvement.

name: Negative (Eccentric) Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar. Jump or step to top position (chin over bar). Lower body as slowly as possible (5-10 seconds). Repeat.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar with dip belt and weight plates or weighted vest. Perform standard pull-up with additional load.

name: Muscle-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar with clearance above. Explosive pull-up transitioning above the bar into a dip press. Advanced calisthenics movement.

name: Commando Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, hands staggered one in front of the other (perpendicular grip). Pull head to one side of bar, alternate sides.

name: Archer Pull-Up
setupNotes: Wide grip on pull-up bar. Pull toward one hand while extending the other arm straight. Alternate sides. Advanced unilateral progression.

name: Seated Cable Row — Neutral Grip (V-Handle)
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, V-handle attached. Feet on foot plate, knees slightly bent. Pull handle to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades.

name: Seated Cable Row — Wide Grip
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, wide lat bar or straight bar. Overhand grip. Pull to lower chest, elbows out to sides.

name: Seated Cable Row — Underhand Grip
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, straight bar with underhand grip at shoulder-width. Pull to lower chest, elbows close to body.

name: Seated Cable Row — Single-Arm — Left Arm
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, D-handle. One arm at a time. Slight rotation toward working side. Full stretch and squeeze.

name: Seated Cable Row — Single-Arm — Right Arm
setupNotes: Seated cable row station, D-handle. One arm at a time. Slight rotation toward working side. Full stretch and squeeze.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row — Left Arm
setupNotes: Right hand and right knee on flat bench, left foot on floor, flat back. Dumbbell in left hand hanging below shoulder — row to left hip, elbow close to body. Squeeze the lat at the top.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row — Right Arm
setupNotes: Left hand and left knee on flat bench, right foot on floor, flat back. Dumbbell in right hand hanging below shoulder — row to right hip, elbow close to body. Squeeze the lat at the top.

name: Bench-Supported One-Arm Row — Left Arm
setupNotes: Incline bench at ~30 degrees, chest against pad. Dumbbell in left hand — row to left hip, elbow tracking close to body. Bench prevents momentum for strict lat work.

name: Bench-Supported One-Arm Row — Right Arm
setupNotes: Incline bench at ~30 degrees, chest against pad. Dumbbell in right hand — row to right hip, elbow tracking close to body. Bench prevents momentum for strict lat work.

name: Renegade Row
setupNotes: Push-up position with hands on dumbbells (hex dumbbells preferred). Row one dumbbell to hip while stabilising on the other. Alternate sides.

name: Kroc Row — Left Arm
setupNotes: One hand on bench or rack for support. Heavy dumbbell, slight torso rotation allowed. High-rep, explosive rowing for back thickness.

name: Kroc Row — Right Arm
setupNotes: One hand on bench or rack for support. Heavy dumbbell, slight torso rotation allowed. High-rep, explosive rowing for back thickness.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row — Overhand
setupNotes: Standing, hinge at hips ~45 degrees. Barbell hanging at arm's length, overhand grip. Row bar to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row — Underhand
setupNotes: Same hinge position as overhand row. Underhand (supinated) grip at shoulder-width. Row to lower stomach, elbows close to body.

name: Pendlay Row
setupNotes: Barbell on floor. Hinge at hips until torso is parallel to floor. Explosive row from dead stop on each rep. Bar returns to floor between reps.

name: Yates Row
setupNotes: Standing, slight forward lean (~20-30 degrees). Underhand grip on barbell. Row to lower stomach with controlled form. Less lower back stress.

name: Seal Row
setupNotes: Lie face down on elevated flat bench (bench on blocks/plates). Dumbbells or barbell hang below. Row with no leg drive or momentum — pure back.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
setupNotes: Incline bench at ~30-45 degrees, chest against pad. Dumbbell in each hand. Row both dumbbells simultaneously. No momentum.

name: T-Bar Row — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: T-bar row machine or landmine setup with V-handle. Straddle bar, neutral grip. Hinge at hips, row to chest.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
setupNotes: Chest-supported T-bar machine. Lie face down on pad. Grip handles, row to chest. Machine prevents cheating.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Row — Left Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment. Straddle bar, grip end with one hand. Row to hip with slight rotation. Stable stance.

name: Single-Arm Landmine Row — Right Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment. Straddle bar, grip end with one hand. Row to hip with slight rotation. Stable stance.

name: Smith Machine Bent-Over Row — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Smith machine, bar at knee height. Hinge at hips, grip bar overhand. Row to lower chest. Guided bar path.

name: Smith Machine Bent-Over Row — Underhand Grip
setupNotes: Smith machine, bar at knee height. Hinge at hips, grip bar underhand. Row to lower chest. Guided bar path.

name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
setupNotes: High cable pulley, straight bar or rope attachment. Stand facing machine, arms extended overhead. Pull bar down to thighs in arc, lats engaged.

name: Single-Arm Straight-Arm Pulldown — Left Arm
setupNotes: High cable pulley, D-handle. Stand facing machine. One arm at a time, pull handle to hip in arc. Full lat stretch at top.

name: Single-Arm Straight-Arm Pulldown — Right Arm
setupNotes: High cable pulley, D-handle. Stand facing machine. One arm at a time, pull handle to hip in arc. Full lat stretch at top.

name: Inverted Row — Standard — Overhand Grip
setupNotes: Barbell in rack at waist height, or Smith machine bar. Hang underneath, body straight. Pull chest to bar. Use overhand grip position.

name: Inverted Row — Standard — Underhand Grip
setupNotes: Barbell in rack at waist height, or Smith machine bar. Hang underneath, body straight. Pull chest to bar. Use underhand grip position.

name: Inverted Row — Standard — Neutral Grip
setupNotes: Barbell in rack at waist height, or Smith machine bar. Hang underneath, body straight. Pull chest to bar. Use neutral grip position.

name: Inverted Row — Feet Elevated
setupNotes: Same as standard inverted row but feet on bench or box. Increases difficulty by raising body angle closer to horizontal.

name: Inverted Row — Weighted
setupNotes: Standard inverted row setup. Place weight plate on chest or wear weighted vest for additional resistance.

name: Inverted Row — Single-Arm — Left Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in rack. Grip bar with one hand, other arm at side or behind back. Row body up with one arm. Advanced unilateral.

name: Inverted Row — Single-Arm — Right Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in rack. Grip bar with one hand, other arm at side or behind back. Row body up with one arm. Advanced unilateral.

name: Dead Hang
setupNotes: Pull-up bar at height allowing full hang without feet touching floor. Overhand grip, relax shoulders, decompress spine. Timed hold.

name: Active Dead Hang
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, full hang. Engage lats and depress shoulder blades without bending elbows. Scapular activation drill.

name: Weighted Dead Hang
setupNotes: Pull-up bar with dip belt and plates or weighted vest. Full hang, grip endurance and spinal decompression under load.

name: Scapular Pull-Up
setupNotes: Pull-up bar, overhand grip. From dead hang, retract and depress scapulae to raise body slightly without bending elbows. Lat activation.

name: Back Extension — Standard (Machine)
setupNotes: Hyper extension / back extension bench. Pad at hip crease, feet anchored. Hinge at hips down and up. Hands behind head or crossed on chest.

name: Back Extension — Weighted
setupNotes: Same setup as standard. Hold weight plate or dumbbell against chest for added resistance. Controlled tempo.

name: Back Extension — Glute-Bias
setupNotes: Back extension bench. Round upper back slightly, focus on squeezing glutes at top. Feet turned slightly outward. Slower tempo.

name: Reverse Snow Angels — Standard
setupNotes: Lie prone on mat, arms extended overhead. Sweep arms in arc from overhead to hips and back, keeping arms off the ground throughout.

name: Reverse Snow Angels — Weighted
setupNotes: Same prone position. Hold very light dumbbells (1-2 kg) in each hand. Slow arc from overhead to hips and back.

name: Conventional Barbell Deadlift
setupNotes: Barbell on floor, feet hip-width (conventional stance). Mixed or double-overhand grip just outside knees. Flat back, chest up — drive through heels to lockout.

name: Sumo Barbell Deadlift
setupNotes: Barbell on floor, wide stance with toes pointed out (sumo). Grip bar between knees, arms straight. Flat back, chest up — drive through heels to lockout.

name: Trap Bar Row
setupNotes: Trap bar loaded, hinge at hips. Grip both handles with neutral grip. Row to torso, squeeze upper back. Neutral grip reduces bicep strain.

name: Barbell Good Morning
setupNotes: Barbell on upper back (like a squat). Feet hip-width apart. Hinge at hips, push hips back, lower torso to roughly parallel — stand up by driving hips forward.

name: Dumbbell Good Morning
setupNotes: Hold dumbbells at shoulders or behind head. Feet hip-width apart. Hinge at hips, push hips back, lower torso to roughly parallel — stand up by driving hips forward.

name: Meadows Row — Left Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment. Stand perpendicular to the bar in a staggered stance with right foot forward. Overhand grip on the end of the bar with the left hand — row to left hip with slight torso rotation. Targets the lats and upper back.

name: Meadows Row — Right Arm
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment. Stand perpendicular to the bar in a staggered stance with left foot forward. Overhand grip on the end of the bar with the right hand — row to right hip with slight torso rotation. Targets the lats and upper back.

name: GHD Back Extension
setupNotes: Glute-Ham Developer machine. Pad at hip crease, feet anchored on platform. Hinge at hips, lower torso, extend back to horizontal or slight hyperextension.

name: Reverse Hyper
setupNotes: Reverse hyper machine. Lie face down, hips at edge of pad, grip handles. Extend legs behind and upward using glutes/hamstrings. Controlled swing.

name: Barbell Curl — Standing
setupNotes: Standing, barbell with shoulder-width grip. Elbows pinned to sides. Curl to shoulder height, controlled lower. Avoid swinging torso.

name: EZ-Bar Curl — Standing — Wide Grip
setupNotes: Standing, EZ-bar with comfortable wrist angle. Wide Grip position. Curl to shoulders, squeeze at top, controlled eccentric.

name: EZ-Bar Curl — Standing — Narrow Grip
setupNotes: Standing, EZ-bar with comfortable wrist angle. Narrow Grip position. Curl to shoulders, squeeze at top, controlled eccentric.

name: Reverse Barbell Curl
setupNotes: Standing, overhand (pronated) grip on barbell at shoulder-width. Curl up keeping palms down. Targets brachioradialis and forearm extensors.

name: Drag Curl — Barbell
setupNotes: Standing, barbell at hip level. Instead of curling in arc, drag bar up body by pulling elbows straight back. Bar stays in contact with torso.

name: Spider Curl — Barbell
setupNotes: Prone on incline bench (chest at top). Arms hang straight down, barbell in hands. Curl up with zero momentum. Constant tension.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Biceps Curl — Standing
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Alternating curl. Full supination at top, controlled lower. Elbows stationary.

name: Simultaneous Dumbbell Biceps Curl — Standing
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Simultaneous curl. Full supination at top, controlled lower. Elbows stationary.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl — Seated
setupNotes: Seated on incline bench at ~45-60 degrees. Dumbbells hang at sides behind torso. Curl up, long head of biceps gets extra stretch.

name: Concentration Curl — Seated — Left Arm
setupNotes: Seated on bench, left elbow braced against inner left thigh. Dumbbell in left hand hanging toward the floor — curl up in strict isolation, squeezing the biceps at the top. No torso movement.

name: Concentration Curl — Seated — Right Arm
setupNotes: Seated on bench, right elbow braced against inner right thigh. Dumbbell in right hand hanging toward the floor — curl up in strict isolation, squeezing the biceps at the top. No torso movement.

name: Standard Hammer Curl — Standing
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbells at sides with neutral (palms-in) grip throughout. Curl up keeping thumbs pointing up. Standard.

name: Alternating Hammer Curl — Standing
setupNotes: Standing tall, dumbbell in each hand at sides with neutral (palms-in) grip. Curl one arm at a time, thumbs pointing up, lowering under control before the other side curls. Targets the brachialis and brachioradialis.

name: Incline Hammer Curl
setupNotes: Seated on incline bench at ~45 degrees. Dumbbells at sides with neutral grip. Curl up — incline increases stretch on brachialis.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
setupNotes: Standing, curl dumbbell across body toward opposite shoulder with neutral grip. Targets brachialis and brachioradialis. Alternate arms.

name: Twisting/Supinating Curl
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbells at sides with neutral grip. As you curl up, rotate wrist from neutral to supinated (palms up). Squeeze at top.

name: Cable Biceps Curl — Straight Bar
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, straight bar or EZ-bar attachment. Stand facing machine, curl bar to shoulders. Constant cable tension throughout.

name: Cable Rope Curl
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, rope attachment. Stand facing machine, grip rope ends. Curl up and twist rope outward at top for peak contraction.

name: Behind-the-Back Cable Curl
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, D-handle. Stand facing away from machine, arm extended behind. Curl forward against cable for unique stretch-focused angle.

name: High Cable Curl
setupNotes: Dual cable station, pulleys set high with D-handles. Stand centred, arms extended to sides. Curl handles toward ears — front double bicep position.

name: Single-Arm Cable Curl — Left Arm
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, D-handle. Stand facing machine. Curl one arm at a time. Free hand can brace on machine for stability.

name: Single-Arm Cable Curl — Right Arm
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, D-handle. Stand facing machine. Curl one arm at a time. Free hand can brace on machine for stability.

name: Reverse Cable Curl
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, straight bar. Overhand (pronated) grip. Curl up keeping palms down. Cable provides constant tension on forearm extensors.

name: EZ-Bar Preacher Curl
setupNotes: Preacher curl bench, EZ-bar. Upper arms flat on pad, armpits at top of pad. Curl up, controlled lower — no momentum or bouncing at bottom.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
setupNotes: Preacher curl bench, dumbbell in one hand. Upper arm flat on pad. Curl up, squeeze at top, slow eccentric. Full stretch at bottom.

name: Cable Preacher Curl
setupNotes: Preacher bench positioned in front of low cable pulley. EZ-bar or straight bar attachment. Constant tension through full range of motion.

name: Zottman Curl
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbells at sides. Curl up with supinated grip (palms up), rotate to pronated grip (palms down) at top, lower slowly with pronated grip.

name: Waiter Curl
setupNotes: Standing, hold one dumbbell vertically with both palms under the top plate. Curl up keeping elbows close. Long head emphasis at peak contraction.

name: 21s — EZ-Bar
setupNotes: Standing, EZ-bar. Perform 7 reps bottom-half range, 7 reps top-half range, 7 reps full range — 21 total. No rest between segments.

name: Triceps Pushdown — Straight Bar
setupNotes: High cable pulley, straight bar attachment. Stand facing machine, elbows pinned to sides. Push bar down to full extension, controlled return.

name: Triceps Pushdown — Rope
setupNotes: High cable pulley, rope attachment. Stand facing machine. Push down and split rope apart at bottom for extra contraction. Elbows stationary.

name: Triceps Pushdown — V-Bar
setupNotes: High cable pulley, V-bar attachment. Neutral grip. Push down to full extension. Comfortable on wrists, good triceps isolation.

name: Triceps Pushdown — Reverse Grip
setupNotes: High cable pulley, straight bar with underhand (supinated) grip. Push down to full extension. Emphasises medial head of triceps.

name: Standing Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
setupNotes: Standing, hold one heavy dumbbell with both hands behind head, elbows pointing up. Extend arms overhead to lockout.

name: Seated Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
setupNotes: Seated, hold one heavy dumbbell with both hands behind head, elbows pointing up. Extend arms overhead to lockout.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Extension — Left Arm
setupNotes: Standing or seated, one dumbbell behind head in one hand. Elbow points upward. Extend to lockout, controlled lower behind head.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Extension — Right Arm
setupNotes: Standing or seated, one dumbbell behind head in one hand. Elbow points upward. Extend to lockout, controlled lower behind head.

name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension — Rope
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, rope attachment. Face away from machine, arms overhead. Extend forward from behind head to full lockout.

name: Single-Arm Cable Overhead Extension — Left Arm
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, D-handle. Face away, one arm overhead. Extend forward to lockout. Free hand can brace on thigh for stability.

name: Single-Arm Cable Overhead Extension — Right Arm
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, D-handle. Face away, one arm overhead. Extend forward to lockout. Free hand can brace on thigh for stability.

name: Barbell Skull Crusher
setupNotes: Flat bench, barbell or EZ-bar. Arms extended over face/forehead. Lower bar by bending elbows to forehead level, extend back up. Spotter recommended.

name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
setupNotes: Flat or slight incline bench, EZ-bar. Grip at narrow angle. Lower to forehead, extend to lockout. EZ-bar reduces wrist strain.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
setupNotes: Flat bench, dumbbells with neutral grip above face. Lower dumbbells by bending elbows to beside ears, extend back up.

name: Cable Skull Crusher
setupNotes: Flat bench positioned at low cable pulley, straight bar attachment. Arms extended over chest, lower by bending elbows, extend back.

name: Bench Dip — Standard
setupNotes: Hands on edge of bench behind body, fingers forward. Feet on floor, legs extended or bent. Lower body by bending elbows, press back up.

name: Bench Dip — Weighted
setupNotes: Same as standard bench dip. Place weight plate on lap for additional resistance. Spotter may assist with plate placement.

name: Parallel Bar Dip — Triceps Focus
setupNotes: Parallel dip bars. Upright torso (not leaning forward), elbows close to body and pointing back. Lower until elbows at 90 degrees, press up.

name: Assisted Parallel Dip
setupNotes: Assisted dip/pull-up machine. Kneel or stand on pad, select counterweight. Upright torso for triceps focus. Full range of motion.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press — Barbell
setupNotes: Flat bench, barbell with hands 12-14 inches apart (inside shoulder-width). Lower bar to lower chest, elbows close to body. Press to lockout.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press — Smith Machine
setupNotes: Flat bench in Smith machine. Narrow grip. Lower to lower chest with elbows tucked, press to lockout. Machine guides path.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press — Dumbbell (Neutral)
setupNotes: Flat bench, dumbbells pressed together with neutral grip above chest. Press up keeping dumbbells touching. Elbows close to body.

name: Diamond Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands on floor with index fingers and thumbs touching (diamond shape). Body in straight line. Lower chest to hands, press up. Triceps-dominant.

name: JM Press
setupNotes: Flat bench, barbell or EZ-bar. Hybrid between skull crusher and close-grip press. Lower bar toward chin/upper chest at ~45 degree angle, press back up.

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
setupNotes: One hand and knee on bench (like one-arm row position). Dumbbell in working hand, upper arm parallel to floor. Extend forearm back to lockout.

name: Tate Press
setupNotes: Flat bench, dumbbells extended above chest with palms facing feet. Lower dumbbells inward so ends touch on chest, press back up.

name: Barbell Wrist Curl
setupNotes: Seated, forearms resting on thighs or preacher bench, palms up. Barbell in hands. Curl wrists upward, controlled lower. Let bar roll to fingers for extra range.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
setupNotes: Seated, forearms on thighs or preacher bench, palms down. Barbell in hands. Extend wrists upward, controlled lower. Light weight, high reps.

name: Farmer's Walk
setupNotes: Standing, heavy dumbbell or farmer's walk handles in each hand at sides. Walk in straight line for distance or time. Tall posture, shoulders packed.

name: Plate Pinch Hold
setupNotes: Standing, pinch two smooth weight plates together with fingers on one side and thumb on other. Hold for time. Builds pinch grip strength.

name: Wrist Roller
setupNotes: Standing or arms extended in front. Wrist roller device with weight hanging from rope. Roll rope up by rotating wrists, then lower. Both directions.

name: Behind-the-Back Barbell Wrist Curl
setupNotes: Standing, barbell held behind body at arms length, palms facing back. Curl wrists up, controlled lower. Standing allows heavier loads.

name: Towel Grip Hang
setupNotes: Drape thick towel over pull-up bar. Grip towel with both hands (one on each side). Hang for time. Extreme forearm and grip challenge.

name: Barbell Back Squat — Standard
setupNotes: Power rack, bar on upper traps (high bar) or rear delts (low bar). Feet shoulder-width apart. Descend until thighs parallel or below — drive up through heels.

name: Barbell Back Squat — Wide Stance
setupNotes: Power rack, bar on upper traps (high bar) or rear delts (low bar). Wide stance, toes angled out. Descend until thighs parallel or below — drive up through heels.

name: Barbell Front Squat
setupNotes: Power rack, bar across front delts in front rack (clean grip) or cross-arm position. Elbows high. Descend to parallel or below, upright torso.

name: Box Squat — Barbell
setupNotes: Power rack with box or bench behind you at parallel-depth. Bar on back. Sit back to box, brief pause, drive up explosively. Controlled descent.

name: Front Pause Squat — Barbell
setupNotes: Power rack, front squat setup. Descend to bottom position, hold for 2-3 seconds without relaxing tension, then drive up. Builds strength off bottom.

name: Back Pause Squat — Barbell
setupNotes: Power rack, back squat setup. Descend to bottom position, hold for 2-3 seconds without relaxing tension, then drive up. Builds strength off bottom.

name: Safety Bar Squat
setupNotes: Safety squat bar on shoulders in power rack. Handles in front for balance. Descend to parallel, drive up. Easier on shoulders than straight bar.

name: Sumo Squat — Barbell
setupNotes: Bar on back, wide stance with toes pointed out ~45 degrees. Descend between legs, knees track over toes. Adductor and glute emphasis.

name: Zercher Squat
setupNotes: Bar held in crook of elbows at chest height. Feet shoulder-width. Squat down between arms, bar stays in elbow crease. Pad bar with towel.

name: Smith Machine Squat
setupNotes: Smith machine, bar on upper back. Feet slightly forward of bar. Descend to parallel, press up. Machine guides bar path vertically.

name: Goblet Squat — Standard
setupNotes: Standing, hold one dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height with both hands. Feet shoulder-width. Squat down, elbows inside knees at bottom. Standard stance.

name: Goblet Squat — Elevated Heels
setupNotes: Standing on a small plate or wedge with heels elevated, hold one dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height with both hands. Squat down, elbows inside knees at bottom. Elevated heels bias load onto the quads.

name: Goblet Squat — B-Stance
setupNotes: Standing with one foot half a step behind (heel up, toe lightly anchored), hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height with both hands. Squat down driving mainly through the front leg. Unilateral emphasis with bilateral stability.

name: Hack Squat — Machine
setupNotes: Hack squat machine, shoulders under pads, back against pad. Feet shoulder-width on platform. Descend to parallel or below, press up.

name: Belt Squat
setupNotes: Belt squat machine. Attach belt around hips to weight, stand on elevated platforms. Squat down and up — zero spinal loading. Quad and glute focus.

name: Sissy Squat
setupNotes: Standing, hold something for balance. Lean back, push knees forward over toes, lower body. Extreme quad stretch. Can use sissy squat bench.

name: Pendulum Squat
setupNotes: Pendulum squat machine. Shoulders under pads, feet on platform. Machine pivots on arc. Squat deep with constant tension. Very quad-dominant.

name: Leg Press — Standard — Hip-Width
setupNotes: Leg press machine. Sit with back against pad, feet hip-width on platform. Release safety catches, lower weight until knees at ~90 degrees, press up.

name: Leg Press — Standard — Hip-Width — Left Leg
setupNotes: Leg press machine, back against pad, left foot centred on platform (right foot off). Lower weight until knee reaches ~90 degrees, press up through the heel. Lighter load than bilateral — exposes left-side imbalances.

name: Leg Press — Standard — Hip-Width — Right Leg
setupNotes: Leg press machine, back against pad, right foot centred on platform (left foot off). Lower weight until knee reaches ~90 degrees, press up through the heel. Lighter load than bilateral — exposes right-side imbalances.

name: Leg Press — Standard — Wide
setupNotes: Leg press machine. Sit with back against pad, feet wide on platform. Release safety catches, lower weight until knees at ~90 degrees, press up.

name: Leg Press — Standard — Narrow
setupNotes: Leg press machine. Sit with back against pad, feet narrow on platform. Release safety catches, lower weight until knees at ~90 degrees, press up.

name: Leg Press — High Foot Placement
setupNotes: Leg press machine, feet placed high on platform. Greater hamstring and glute emphasis. Lower until knees at ~90 degrees, press up.

name: Leg Press — Low Foot Placement
setupNotes: Leg press machine, feet placed low on platform. Greater quad emphasis — deeper knee flexion. Watch knee tracking over toes.

name: Single-Leg Press — Left Leg
setupNotes: Leg press machine, back against pad, left foot centred on platform, right foot off. Press the weight up with the left leg, lower under control to ~90 degrees. Lighter load than bilateral. Exposes left-side strength imbalances.

name: Single-Leg Press — Right Leg
setupNotes: Leg press machine, back against pad, right foot centred on platform, left foot off. Press the weight up with the right leg, lower under control to ~90 degrees. Lighter load than bilateral. Exposes right-side strength imbalances.

name: Calf Press on Leg Press
setupNotes: Leg press machine, toes only on bottom edge of platform. Extend ankles (plantar flex) to press weight, controlled return. Full range of motion.

name: Walking Lunge — Bodyweight
setupNotes: Open floor space (10+ metres). Step forward into lunge, back knee toward floor, push off front foot into next step. Continuous forward motion.

name: Walking Lunge — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Open floor space, dumbbells at sides. Step forward into a deep lunge — front knee tracking over toes. Push off front foot, bring rear foot forward into next lunge.

name: Walking Lunge — Barbell
setupNotes: Open floor space, barbell on upper back. Step forward into a deep lunge — front knee tracking over toes. Push off front foot, bring rear foot forward into next lunge.

name: Walking Lunge — Front Rack
setupNotes: Open floor space, barbell in front rack position. Step forward into a deep lunge — front knee tracking over toes. Push off front foot, bring rear foot forward into next lunge.

name: Reverse Lunge — Dumbbell/Barbell
setupNotes: Standing with dumbbells at sides or barbell on back. Step backward into lunge, lower until front thigh is parallel. Return to start.

name: Bodyweight Lateral Lunge
setupNotes: Standing, step wide to one side, bend stepping leg, keep other leg straight. Push off to return. Using bodyweight.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
setupNotes: Standing, step wide to one side, bend stepping leg, keep other leg straight. Push off to return. Using dumbbell.

name: Jumping / Plyo Lunge
setupNotes: Start in lunge position. Jump explosively, switch legs mid-air, land in opposite lunge. Continuous alternating. Cardio and power.

name: Overhead Walking Lunge
setupNotes: Dumbbells or barbell held overhead with arms locked out. Walk forward in lunges. Extreme core and shoulder stability demand.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Dumbbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Right foot laces-down on a bench behind you, left foot 2–3 feet forward, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Lower until the left thigh is parallel. Drive up through the front heel — quad and glute emphasis on the left leg.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Dumbbell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Left foot laces-down on a bench behind you, right foot 2–3 feet forward, dumbbell in each hand at sides. Lower until the right thigh is parallel. Drive up through the front heel — quad and glute emphasis on the right leg.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack — Left Leg
setupNotes: Right foot rear-elevated on a bench, barbell racked across the upper back. Lower into a split squat until the left front thigh is parallel, then drive through the left heel to stand. Trains the left quad and glute under spinal load.
parentName: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack — Right Leg
setupNotes: Left foot rear-elevated on a bench, barbell racked across the upper back. Lower into a split squat until the right front thigh is parallel, then drive through the right heel to stand. Trains the right quad and glute under spinal load.
parentName: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Back Rack

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Front Rack — Left Leg
setupNotes: Right foot rear-elevated on a bench, barbell in the front rack across the shoulders, elbows up. Lower until the left front thigh is parallel, drive through the left heel to stand. Front rack forces an upright torso — heavier left-quad emphasis.
parentName: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Front Rack

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Front Rack — Right Leg
setupNotes: Left foot rear-elevated on a bench, barbell in the front rack across the shoulders, elbows up. Lower until the right front thigh is parallel, drive through the right heel to stand. Front rack forces an upright torso — heavier right-quad emphasis.
parentName: Bulgarian Split Squat — Barbell — Front Rack

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Paused — Left Leg
setupNotes: Right foot on a bench behind you, left foot forward, dumbbells at sides or barbell on back. Lower until the left thigh is parallel and hold 2–3 seconds before driving up. Removes stretch reflex — builds bottom-position strength.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Paused — Right Leg
setupNotes: Left foot on a bench behind you, right foot forward, dumbbells at sides or barbell on back. Lower until the right thigh is parallel and hold 2–3 seconds before driving up. Removes stretch reflex — builds bottom-position strength.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Jump (Plyo) — Left Leg
setupNotes: Right foot rear-elevated on a bench, bodyweight only. Lower into a split squat then explode upward off the left foot, landing softly back into the split position. Re-stabilise before the next rep. Plyometric power through the left leg.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Jump (Plyo) — Right Leg
setupNotes: Left foot rear-elevated on a bench, bodyweight only. Lower into a split squat then explode upward off the right foot, landing softly back into the split position. Re-stabilise before the next rep. Plyometric power through the right leg.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Front Foot Elevated — Left Leg
setupNotes: Right foot rear-elevated on a bench AND left front foot on a small plate or step. Lower into the deficit split squat — left front thigh well below parallel — then drive up through the left heel. Increased range loads the left glute deeply.
parentName: Bulgarian Split Squat — Front Foot Elevated

name: Bulgarian Split Squat — Front Foot Elevated — Right Leg
setupNotes: Left foot rear-elevated on a bench AND right front foot on a small plate or step. Lower into the deficit split squat — right front thigh well below parallel — then drive up through the right heel. Increased range loads the right glute deeply.
parentName: Bulgarian Split Squat — Front Foot Elevated

name: Step-Up — Dumbbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Sturdy bench or plyo box at knee height. Dumbbells at sides. Plant the left foot fully on the box and drive through the left heel to stand tall — right foot follows or stays grounded for balance. Step down with control through the left leg. Loads the left quad and glute.

name: Step-Up — Dumbbell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Sturdy bench or plyo box at knee height. Dumbbells at sides. Plant the right foot fully on the box and drive through the right heel to stand tall — left foot follows or stays grounded for balance. Step down with control through the right leg. Loads the right quad and glute.

name: Step-Up — Barbell
setupNotes: Bench or box at knee height, barbell on upper back. Step up, stand fully on box, controlled step down. Alternate legs or do all one side.

name: Lateral Step-Up
setupNotes: Stand beside bench or box. Step up sideways onto box with near foot, stand up fully, step down. Works glutes and adductors from lateral angle.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
setupNotes: Upper back on bench, barbell across hip crease (pad the bar). Feet flat on floor, hip-width. Drive hips up to full extension, squeeze glutes. Lower controlled.

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
setupNotes: Upper back on bench inside Smith machine. Bar across hip crease with pad. Plant feet, drive hips up to lockout. Machine guides bar path.

name: Machine Hip Thrust
setupNotes: Dedicated hip thrust / glute drive machine. Sit in machine, back against pad, feet on platform. Drive hips forward to full extension. Squeeze glutes.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust — Left Leg
setupNotes: Upper back on a bench, left foot planted hip-width, right knee raised or leg extended. Drive the hips up to lockout through the left heel, squeeze the left glute hard at the top, lower under control. Heavier than bilateral on a per-leg basis.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust — Right Leg
setupNotes: Upper back on a bench, right foot planted hip-width, left knee raised or leg extended. Drive the hips up to lockout through the right heel, squeeze the right glute hard at the top, lower under control. Heavier than bilateral on a per-leg basis.

name: Banded Hip Thrust
setupNotes: Upper back on bench, resistance band across hips anchored by feet or heavy dumbbells. Drive hips up to full extension. Band adds tension at top.

name: Romanian Deadlift — Barbell
setupNotes: Standing, barbell at hip level. Slight knee bend, hinge at hips pushing them back, lower bar along thighs to mid-shin. Flat back, squeeze glutes to return.

name: Romanian Deadlift — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Standing, dumbbell in each hand at front of thighs. Same hip hinge as barbell version. Allows more natural arm path.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift — Dumbbell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the left leg, dumbbell in the right hand. Hinge at the left hip and extend the right leg behind for counterbalance — back flat, dumbbell tracking close to the shin. Drive through the left heel to return upright. Loads the left hamstring and glute.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift — Dumbbell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the right leg, dumbbell in the left hand. Hinge at the right hip and extend the left leg behind for counterbalance — back flat, dumbbell tracking close to the shin. Drive through the right heel to return upright. Loads the right hamstring and glute.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift — Kettlebell — Left Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the left leg, kettlebell in the right hand. Hinge at the left hip and extend the right leg behind for counterbalance, bell tracking close to the shin. Drive through the left heel to return upright. Loads the left hamstring and glute.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift — Kettlebell — Right Leg
setupNotes: Standing on the right leg, kettlebell in the left hand. Hinge at the right hip and extend the left leg behind for counterbalance, bell tracking close to the shin. Drive through the right heel to return upright. Loads the right hamstring and glute.

name: Romanian Deadlift — Trap Bar
setupNotes: Standing inside trap bar. Slight knee bend, hinge at hips, lower bar along sides. Neutral grip is easier on lower back.

name: B-Stance Romanian Deadlift
setupNotes: Standing with one foot half a step behind (heel up). Most weight on front leg. Hinge at hips with dumbbells. Unilateral emphasis with bilateral stability.

name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
setupNotes: Standing, kettlebell in each hand or single kettlebell in both. Same hip hinge pattern. Kettlebell shape allows natural hand position.

name: Seated Leg Curl
setupNotes: Seated leg curl machine. Adjust back pad and shin pad. Curl heels toward glutes, controlled return to start. Full range of motion.

name: Lying (Prone) Leg Curl
setupNotes: Lying face down on leg curl machine. Pad on lower calves/ankles. Curl heels toward glutes, squeeze hamstrings at top, controlled lower.

name: Standing Leg Curl — Cable
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, ankle cuff attachment. Stand facing machine, strap on one ankle. Curl heel toward glute, controlled return. Hold something for balance.

name: Leg Extension — Seated (Double-Leg)
setupNotes: Seated leg extension machine. Shin pad on lower shins. Extend legs to full lockout, squeeze quads at top, controlled lower.

name: Leg Extension — Single-Leg — Left Leg
setupNotes: Seated leg extension machine, shin pad on lower left shin, right leg relaxed to the side. Extend the left leg to full lockout, squeeze the quad, control the lower. Lighter load — exposes and corrects left-side imbalances.

name: Leg Extension — Single-Leg — Right Leg
setupNotes: Seated leg extension machine, shin pad on lower right shin, left leg relaxed to the side. Extend the right leg to full lockout, squeeze the quad, control the lower. Lighter load — exposes and corrects right-side imbalances.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
setupNotes: Kneeling on mat, ankles anchored (partner holds, GHD pad, or loaded barbell). Lower body forward under control, catch yourself and push back up. Eccentric hamstring.

name: Reverse Nordic Curl
setupNotes: Kneeling upright on mat (padding under knees). Lean backward slowly keeping hips extended. Feel quad stretch, return to upright. Quad eccentric.

name: Standing Calf Raise — Machine
setupNotes: Standing calf raise machine. Shoulders under pads, balls of feet on edge of platform. Rise onto toes, full extension, controlled lower for stretch at bottom.

name: Seated Calf Raise — Machine
setupNotes: Seated calf raise machine. Knee pad on lower thighs, balls of feet on platform. Rise onto toes, squeeze at top, controlled lower. Targets soleus.

name: Dumbbell Standing Calf Raise
setupNotes: Standing on edge of step or plate, dumbbell in one hand, other hand for balance. Rise onto toes, controlled lower. Alternate hands.

name: Standing Smith Machine Calf Raise
setupNotes: Smith machine, bar on upper traps. Balls of feet on edge of platform/plates. Standing variation. Rise and lower with full range.

name: Seated Smith Machine Calf Raise
setupNotes: Smith machine, bar on upper traps. Balls of feet on edge of platform/plates. Seated variation. Rise and lower with full range.

name: Bodyweight Calf Raise on Step
setupNotes: Standing on edge of step or platform (no additional weight). Rise onto toes, controlled lower below platform level for full stretch. Both feet.

name: Wall Sit — Standard
setupNotes: Back flat against wall, slide down until thighs parallel to floor. Knees at 90 degrees, directly over ankles. Hold for prescribed time.

name: Wall Sit — Single-Leg — Left Leg
setupNotes: Back flat against the wall, knees bent to ~90 degrees as in a standard wall sit. Extend the right leg straight forward, all weight on the left leg. Hold for time. Significantly harder — isometric load on the left quad.

name: Wall Sit — Single-Leg — Right Leg
setupNotes: Back flat against the wall, knees bent to ~90 degrees as in a standard wall sit. Extend the left leg straight forward, all weight on the right leg. Hold for time. Significantly harder — isometric load on the right quad.

name: Wall Sit — Weighted
setupNotes: Standard wall sit position with dumbbell or weight plate on thighs. Increases quad demand. Maintain flat back against wall.

name: Hip Abductor Machine
setupNotes: Seated hip abduction machine. Sit with outer thighs against pads. Push legs outward against resistance, controlled return. Targets glute medius.

name: Hip Adductor Machine
setupNotes: Seated hip adduction machine. Sit with inner thighs against pads. Squeeze legs together against resistance, controlled release. Inner thigh focus.

name: Glute Kickback Machine
setupNotes: Standing or kneeling at glute kickback machine. Pad behind ankle or knee. Push leg back and up, squeezing glute at top. Controlled return.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, ankle cuff on one ankle. Face machine, slight lean forward holding frame. Kick leg back and up, squeeze glute. Controlled return.

name: Cable Pull-Through
setupNotes: Low cable pulley, rope attachment. Face away from machine, straddle cable. Hinge at hips, let rope pull through legs, then drive hips forward to standing.

name: Donkey Kick — Cable/Machine — Left
setupNotes: Kneeling at the cable machine with an ankle cuff on the left ankle, or standing at a glute kickback machine with the left foot on the platform. Drive the left heel back and up, squeeze the left glute at the top, lower under control. Core braced throughout.

name: Donkey Kick — Cable/Machine — Right
setupNotes: Kneeling at the cable machine with an ankle cuff on the right ankle, or standing at a glute kickback machine with the right foot on the platform. Drive the right heel back and up, squeeze the right glute at the top, lower under control. Core braced throughout.

name: Pallof Press — Standard — Left Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height with a D-handle. Stand with the right side toward the stack, hold the handle with both hands at the chest. Press the arms straight forward and resist the cable pulling you into rotation toward the right. Return to chest. Anti-rotation core work.

name: Pallof Press — Standard — Right Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height with a D-handle. Stand with the left side toward the stack, hold the handle with both hands at the chest. Press the arms straight forward and resist the cable pulling you into rotation toward the left. Return to chest. Anti-rotation core work.

name: Pallof Press — Half-Kneeling — Left Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height. Half-kneeling with the right knee down (closest to the stack), left foot forward. Press the handle out from the chest and resist rotation toward the right. The lower base raises core demand vs standing.

name: Pallof Press — Half-Kneeling — Right Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height. Half-kneeling with the left knee down (closest to the stack), right foot forward. Press the handle out from the chest and resist rotation toward the left. The lower base raises core demand vs standing.

name: Pallof Press — With Rotation — Left Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height. Stand with the right side toward the stack, press the handle out from the chest. From the pressed position slowly rotate the torso away from the stack to the left, then return under control. Combines anti-rotation with controlled rotation.

name: Pallof Press — With Rotation — Right Arm
setupNotes: Cable at chest height. Stand with the left side toward the stack, press the handle out from the chest. From the pressed position slowly rotate the torso away from the stack to the right, then return under control. Combines anti-rotation with controlled rotation.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar with straight arms. Bring knees up to chest level. Controlled lower, avoid swinging. Flex abs, don't just swing legs.

name: Hanging Knee Raise — Side-to-Side
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar. Bring knees up and twist to one side, lower, repeat to other side. Oblique emphasis on the hanging knee raise.

name: Hanging Straight Leg Raise
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar, legs fully straight. Raise legs to horizontal or higher. Controlled lower. Avoid using momentum.

name: Toes-to-Bar
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar, legs straight. Raise toes all the way to touch the bar. Requires hamstring flexibility and strong core. Controlled lower.

name: L-Sit Hang
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar. Raise straight legs to horizontal (L position) and hold. Timed isometric. Core and hip flexor endurance.

name: Hanging Windshield Wipers
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar, raise legs to horizontal. Sweep legs side to side like windshield wipers. Advanced rotational core exercise.

name: Weighted Hanging Leg Raise
setupNotes: Hang from pull-up bar with light dumbbell between feet or ankle weights. Straight-leg raise to horizontal. Controlled eccentric.

name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
setupNotes: Captain's chair / vertical knee raise station. Forearms on pads, back against support. Raise knees to chest, controlled lower.

name: Decline Crunch
setupNotes: Decline bench, feet hooked under pads. Lie back, hands behind head or across chest. Crunch up, lifting shoulder blades off bench. Controlled lower.

name: Decline Twisting Crunch
setupNotes: Same decline bench setup. Crunch up with rotation — right elbow toward left knee, alternate. Engages obliques with rectus abdominis.

name: Weighted Decline Crunch
setupNotes: Decline bench, hold weight plate or dumbbell on chest. Crunch up against added resistance. Controlled eccentric back down.

name: Decline Reverse Crunch
setupNotes: Decline bench, grip bench above head. Bring knees toward chest by lifting hips off bench. Controlled lower. Lower ab emphasis.

name: Cable Woodchop — High-to-Low — Left
setupNotes: Cable at the highest pulley with rope or D-handle. Stand left side toward the stack, both hands on the handle overhead-right. Pull diagonally across the body down to the low-left, rotating through the torso and pivoting the right foot. Trains rotational power and oblique control.

name: Cable Woodchop — High-to-Low — Right
setupNotes: Cable at the highest pulley with rope or D-handle. Stand right side toward the stack, both hands on the handle overhead-left. Pull diagonally across the body down to the low-right, rotating through the torso and pivoting the left foot. Trains rotational power and oblique control.

name: Cable Woodchop — Low-to-High — Left
setupNotes: Cable at the lowest pulley with rope or D-handle. Stand left side toward the stack, both hands on the handle at the low-right hip. Drive diagonally up and across to overhead-left, extending the hips and rotating through the torso. Power from legs and core.

name: Cable Woodchop — Low-to-High — Right
setupNotes: Cable at the lowest pulley with rope or D-handle. Stand right side toward the stack, both hands on the handle at the low-left hip. Drive diagonally up and across to overhead-right, extending the hips and rotating through the torso. Power from legs and core.

name: Cable Woodchop — Horizontal
setupNotes: Cable at chest height. Stand sideways, rotate torso horizontally, pulling cable across body. Feet stay planted, rotation at trunk only.

name: Kneeling Cable Woodchop
setupNotes: Cable at high or low position. Kneel sideways, chop diagonally across body. Kneeling removes leg drive, isolates obliques and trunk rotation.

name: Plank Hip Dips
setupNotes: Forearm plank position. Rotate hips to lower one side toward floor, then other side. Alternating. Controlled rotation, oblique emphasis.

name: Plank Jacks
setupNotes: High or forearm plank position. Jump feet apart and together (like horizontal jumping jacks). Maintain rigid core. Cardio + core.

name: Spiderman Plank
setupNotes: High plank position. Bring one knee to same-side elbow, return, alternate. Engages obliques and hip flexors with each rep.

name: Stability Ball Plank
setupNotes: Forearms on stability ball, feet on floor. Hold plank position. Ball creates instability, demanding more core stabilisation.

name: Ab Machine Crunch
setupNotes: Seated ab crunch machine. Adjust pad at chest or behind head. Select weight. Crunch forward against resistance, controlled return.

name: Kneeling Cable Crunch
setupNotes: High cable pulley, rope attachment. Kneel facing machine, rope behind head. Crunch forward, curling torso, elbows toward knees. Control eccentric.

name: Standing Cable Crunch
setupNotes: High cable pulley, rope behind head. Standing, feet hip-width. Crunch forward against cable resistance. Core stays engaged throughout.

name: Oblique Cable Crunch
setupNotes: High cable pulley, D-handle or rope. Stand sideways to machine. Crunch laterally, pulling toward hip on cable side. Side-bend motion.

name: Stability Ball Roll-In (Knee Tuck)
setupNotes: High plank position with shins on stability ball. Pull knees toward chest, rolling ball forward. Extend back. Controlled tempo.

name: Stability Ball Rollout
setupNotes: Kneel behind stability ball, forearms on ball. Roll ball forward extending body, then pull back to start. Similar to ab wheel.

name: Stability Ball Pike
setupNotes: High plank with feet/shins on stability ball. Pike hips upward, pulling ball toward hands. Legs stay straight. Advanced.

name: Hollow Body Hold
setupNotes: Lie face up, arms extended overhead, legs straight. Lift shoulders and legs off floor, lower back pressed into ground. Banana shape. Hold.

name: Tucked Hollow Hold
setupNotes: Lie face up, knees pulled toward chest, shoulders lifted. Arms at sides or extended. Easier regression of full hollow hold.

name: Hollow Rock
setupNotes: Full hollow body position — arms overhead, legs extended, both off floor. Rock forward and back maintaining rigid body shape.

name: Weighted Hollow Hold
setupNotes: Full hollow body position with light dumbbell in hands and/or between feet. Hold position for prescribed time. Advanced.

name: Russian Twist — Bodyweight
setupNotes: Sit on floor, lean back ~45 degrees, feet off ground or anchored. Clasp hands, rotate torso side to side. V-sit position.

name: Russian Twist — Medicine Ball
setupNotes: Same seated position as bodyweight. Hold medicine ball in both hands. Rotate side to side, touching ball on floor beside hips.

name: Russian Twist — Dumbbell
setupNotes: Same seated V-sit position. Hold one dumbbell with both hands at chest. Rotate side to side. Controlled tempo.

name: Cable Russian Twist
setupNotes: Seated or standing, cable at chest height with D-handle or rope. Hold at chest, rotate torso side to side against cable resistance.

name: Kneeling Ab Wheel Rollout
setupNotes: Kneeling, grip ab wheel. Roll forward extending body toward floor, pull back using core. Prevent lower back sag.

name: Standing Ab Wheel Rollout
setupNotes: Standing, grip ab wheel. Roll forward extending body toward floor, pull back using core. Prevent lower back sag.

name: Dragon Flag
setupNotes: Lie on flat bench, grip bench behind head. Lift entire body off bench in straight line, lower under control without touching bench. Advanced core.

name: Turkish Get-Up — Left
setupNotes: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell in the left hand pressed straight up, eyes on the bell. Move through the get-up sequence — roll to the right elbow, to the right hand, hip up, sweep the right leg through, lunge, stand — keeping the left arm vertically locked. Reverse to the floor. Full-body unilateral control.

name: Turkish Get-Up — Right
setupNotes: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell in the right hand pressed straight up, eyes on the bell. Move through the get-up sequence — roll to the left elbow, to the left hand, hip up, sweep the left leg through, lunge, stand — keeping the right arm vertically locked. Reverse to the floor. Full-body unilateral control.

name: Suitcase Carry — Left
setupNotes: Hold one heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in the left hand at the side. Walk in a straight line keeping the torso tall and shoulders level — resist the load pulling you into a left-side lean. Anti-lateral-flexion through the right obliques and QL.

name: Suitcase Carry — Right
setupNotes: Hold one heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in the right hand at the side. Walk in a straight line keeping the torso tall and shoulders level — resist the load pulling you into a right-side lean. Anti-lateral-flexion through the left obliques and QL.

name: Landmine Rotation
setupNotes: Barbell in landmine attachment. Hold end of bar with both hands at chest level. Rotate torso, moving bar in arc from side to side. Controlled.

name: Power Clean
setupNotes: Barbell on floor, grip just outside knees. First pull to knees, explosive second pull (hips), catch bar on front delts in front rack. Reset to floor.

name: Hang Clean
setupNotes: Barbell at hip level in standing position. Dip-drive hips, explosively pull bar upward, catch on front delts in front rack. Start from hang, not floor.

name: Clean and Press
setupNotes: Perform a power clean from floor to front rack, then press (or push press) overhead to lockout. Lower bar and repeat. Full body compound.

name: Push Press
setupNotes: Bar in front rack on shoulders. Dip knees slightly, drive explosively through legs to press bar overhead to lockout. More weight than strict press.

name: Barbell Snatch
setupNotes: Barbell on floor, very wide grip. Explosive pull from floor, pull body under bar, catch overhead with straight arms in squat. Stand up. Technical lift.

name: Barbell Thruster
setupNotes: Barbell in front rack position on shoulders, feet shoulder-width. Squat to full depth, then drive up explosively and press the bar to overhead lockout in one fluid motion. Full-body power — legs, shoulders and core.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
setupNotes: Dumbbells racked at shoulders with neutral grip, feet shoulder-width. Squat to full depth, then drive up explosively and press the dumbbells to overhead lockout in one fluid motion. Full-body power.

name: Kettlebell Swing
setupNotes: Standing, kettlebell on floor between feet. Hike KB back between legs, drive hips forward explosively to swing KB to chest/eye height. Hinge, not squat.

name: Kettlebell Clean — Left
setupNotes: Single kettlebell on the floor between the feet. Hinge and grip with the left hand, swing the bell back between the legs, then drive the hips and pull the bell up — rotate the wrist so it lands softly in the rack on the left forearm and shoulder. Lower under control. Trains explosive hip drive and unilateral grip.

name: Kettlebell Clean — Right
setupNotes: Single kettlebell on the floor between the feet. Hinge and grip with the right hand, swing the bell back between the legs, then drive the hips and pull the bell up — rotate the wrist so it lands softly in the rack on the right forearm and shoulder. Lower under control. Trains explosive hip drive and unilateral grip.

name: Kettlebell Snatch
setupNotes: Single kettlebell on floor. Explosive swing directly overhead in one motion. Lock out at top, controlled lower through swing. One arm at a time.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
setupNotes: Standing, medicine ball (slam ball) overhead. Slam ball into floor with maximum force using whole body. Pick up and repeat. Use dead bounce slam ball.

name: Standard Box Jump
setupNotes: Plyo box at appropriate height. Stand facing box, quarter squat and swing arms, jump onto box landing softly in squat. Step down. Standard start.

name: Seated Box Jump
setupNotes: Sit on a bench or low box facing a plyo box, feet flat and torso upright. From a dead stop, drive through the feet and jump onto the box, landing softly in a quarter squat. Step down and reset. Develops starting-strength power.

name: Barbell Hang Snatch
setupNotes: Barbell at hip level, wide snatch grip. Dip-drive hips, pull bar overhead, catch with straight arms. Start from hang position, not floor.

name: Wide-Grip Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands placed 6-8 inches wider than shoulders on floor. Body in straight line, core braced. Lower chest to floor, press up.

name: Staggered/Offset Push-Up
setupNotes: One hand placed forward, the other back by ~6 inches. Body straight. Push up, switch hand positions between sets.

name: Archer Push-Up — Left
setupNotes: Very wide hand placement, body in straight line. Lower body toward the left hand while the right arm extends straight out. Press back up through the left side — unilateral chest and tricep emphasis.

name: Archer Push-Up — Right
setupNotes: Very wide hand placement, body in straight line. Lower body toward the right hand while the left arm extends straight out. Press back up through the right side — unilateral chest and tricep emphasis.

name: Clap Push-Up
setupNotes: Standard push-up position on firm floor. Push explosively so hands leave ground, clap, land softly with bent elbows. Plyometric power.

name: Spiderman Push-Up — Left
setupNotes: High plank position, hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. As you lower into the push-up, draw the left knee out to meet the left elbow. Return the leg as you press back up. Adds oblique and hip-flexor work to the chest press.

name: Spiderman Push-Up — Right
setupNotes: High plank position, hands under shoulders, body in a straight line. As you lower into the push-up, draw the right knee out to meet the right elbow. Return the leg as you press back up. Adds oblique and hip-flexor work to the chest press.

name: Pike Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands on floor, hips piked high (inverted V shape). Feet can be on floor or elevated on bench for extra difficulty. Lower head toward floor, press up. Shoulder emphasis.

name: Decline Push-Up
setupNotes: Feet elevated on bench, box, or chair. Hands on floor shoulder-width. Body in straight line from feet to head. Lower chest to floor, press up.

name: Incline Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands on bench, box, or sturdy elevated surface. Feet on floor. Straight body line. Easier regression — lower surface = harder. Full range of motion.

name: Wall Push-Up
setupNotes: Standing arm's-length from wall, hands on wall at shoulder height. Lean in, press back. Beginner regression, control tempo.

name: Knee Push-Up
setupNotes: Hands on floor shoulder-width, knees on mat. Straight line from head to knees. Lower chest to floor, press up. Beginner progression.

name: Negative-Only Push-Up
setupNotes: Standard push-up position. Lower body as slowly as possible (5-8 seconds) to floor. Reset to top position and repeat. Eccentric strength.

name: Push-Up to Renegade Row
setupNotes: Push-up position with hands on hex dumbbells. Perform push-up, then row one dumbbell to hip, alternate. Wide foot stance for stability.

name: Rotational Push-Up — Left
setupNotes: High plank position, body in a straight line. Perform a push-up, then at the top rotate the body open to the left into a side plank — left arm extended toward the ceiling, weight on the right hand. Return to plank and reset. Builds rotational core and shoulder stability.

name: Rotational Push-Up — Right
setupNotes: High plank position, body in a straight line. Perform a push-up, then at the top rotate the body open to the right into a side plank — right arm extended toward the ceiling, weight on the left hand. Return to plank and reset. Builds rotational core and shoulder stability.

name: Plank Up-Down — Standard
setupNotes: Start in forearm plank. Push up to high plank one arm at a time, then lower back to forearms. Alternate lead arm each rep.

name: Plank Shoulder Taps
setupNotes: High plank position, feet slightly wider than hip-width. Tap right hand to left shoulder, left hand to right shoulder. Minimise hip sway.

name: Shoulder Taps with Leg Lift
setupNotes: High plank. Simultaneously lift one hand to opposite shoulder and opposite foot off ground. Double anti-rotation demand.

name: Arm Circles — Forward
setupNotes: Standing, arms extended straight out to sides at shoulder height. Circle arms forward, gradually increasing the size of the circles. Dynamic shoulder warm-up.

name: Arm Circles — Backward
setupNotes: Standing, arms extended straight out to sides at shoulder height. Circle arms backward, gradually increasing the size of the circles. Dynamic shoulder warm-up.

name: Weighted Arm Circles
setupNotes: Standing, light dumbbells (1-3 kg) in each hand, arms extended. Small controlled circles. Forward and backward. Shoulder endurance.

name: Superman Hold
setupNotes: Lie face down on mat, arms extended overhead. Simultaneously lift arms, chest, and legs off floor. Hold, squeezing glutes and back.

name: Alternating Superman
setupNotes: Lie face down, arms overhead. Lift opposite arm and leg simultaneously (right arm + left leg). Alternate sides. Controlled tempo.

name: Superman Pull (W-Pull)
setupNotes: Lie face down, arms overhead. Lift chest and pull elbows back into W position, squeezing shoulder blades together. Extend arms, repeat.

name: Weighted Superman Hold
setupNotes: Same prone position as standard. Hold light dumbbells in hands and/or light ankle weights. Lift and hold. Controlled breathing.

name: Reverse Plank
setupNotes: Sit on floor, hands behind hips, fingers forward. Lift hips until body is straight from shoulders to heels. Squeeze glutes, hold. Triceps and core.

name: Reverse Plank with Leg Lifts
setupNotes: Standard reverse plank position. Alternate lifting one leg at a time, keeping it straight. Adds glute and core demand to hold.

name: Reverse Plank Push-Up (Dip-Style)
setupNotes: Reverse plank position. Bend elbows to lower body, press back up. Like a bench dip but from floor with legs extended straight.

name: Chair Dip
setupNotes: Hands on edge of sturdy chair behind body, fingers forward. Feet on floor. Lower by bending elbows, press back up. Triceps focus.

name: Overhead Arm Reach Hold
setupNotes: Standing, extend both arms straight overhead. Hold for prescribed time. Challenges shoulder endurance and thoracic mobility.

name: Bodyweight Squat
setupNotes: Standing, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out. Arms forward for balance. Squat down to parallel or below. Drive up through heels.

name: Sumo Squat (Wide-Stance)
setupNotes: Wide stance, toes pointed out 45 degrees. Squat straight down between legs, knees track over toes. Adductor and glute focus.

name: Prisoner Squat
